title: Write a value to a dconf key
summary: Change a specific configuration setting in the GNOME dconf database by writing a new value to a key.

steps.explain: Write a new value to a specific dconf key. Replace <KEY_PATH> with the key path and <VALUE> with the new value (enclosed in quotes).

placeholders.name: KEY_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path to the dconf key

placeholders.name: VALUE
placeholders.description: The new value to set (string, int, bool, etc.)

rollback.explain: Reset the key to its default value.

placeholders.name: KEY_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path to the dconf key

warnings: Incorrect values can break desktop settings. Ensure the value format matches the expected type.
